description: Hello neighbors, On behalf of your Colchester Democratic candidates: House Representatives DougBishop, Gayle Pezzo, Sarita Austin, Wendy Critchlow, and Senate candidate KimGleason, we want to extend our heartfelt thanks to the 125 engaged Colchesterresidents who joined us this past Sunday, August 30, 2026 at Airport Park Pavilion.Seeing so many of our neighbors spend their Sunday afternoon coming together to talkabout the issues that matter most to them was both inspiring and encouraging. Yousho

title: Thank you for joining us, Colchester!
